g.text: Bounded, correlated values, reproducible at the same elapsed time.
Selected scenario: baseline, load or fault
Redfish resources updated under the instance lock
Power · Thermal · MemoryMetrics · HealthRollup · Content ETag
Frequent GETs do not speed up simulation. Changing scenarios restarts the trajectory and its window.
